main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: quam autem ab omni Alchymicæ artis praxi aliquamdiu abstinuimus, partim propter malevolentiâ quorūdam suffusos in nos animos, partim propter exantlata varia discrimina (quæ hîc recensere nimis longū foret) partim denique propter offensam eorum, qui cūm nihil horum capiant, tempus in hisce teri nolunt: fit tamen, ut summè etiam prudētes quandoq; solent quæ-re re utrum nè tanti pœnitere à nobis emptum sit, ut siliquas inanes quatuor (ut ipsi loquuntur) posthâc simus desituri, nec ne ? Quibus quin hac ipsâ Cheiragogia nostra respon-derem9 facere nequivim9: non cer-tè quòd Chymicum studium non summi faciendum censeamus: sed quòd temporis usura, & vocatio-nis necessitas hujus rei negotiatio-nem
main_text.notes: The text ends with the word "nem" set flush right, a catchword-like continuation of "negotiationem" split across the line; the line is not a catchword. Some characters in the first lines are uncertain, notably "exantlata" and "malevolentiâ"; the marks "9" after "derem" and "nequivim" are printed superscript numerals as they appear. No page number, running head or signature is printed.
